result.summary: The page renders cleanly with no obvious layout breakage, overlapping elements, or missing images. The only findings are minor: the inactive bottom navigation labels are light gray and may have borderline contrast. The clipped category chip, clipped carousel card, and cut-off pizza card at the bottom were excluded as intentional scroll behavior.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels (Search, Orders, Profile) and icons appear in light gray on white, which may fall below the recommended 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the inactive nav label and icon color to meet WCAG AA contrast, while keeping the active green state distinct.
